dataset.name: Wisconsin resectable-melanoma hu14.18-IL2 cohort (GSE133713)
dataset.description: Independent advanced-melanoma clinical-trial cohort with bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Twenty-three patients with resectable recurrent stage III or IV melanoma contributed one FFPE resection specimen each. TRACE Explorer retains the 21 patients who received hu14.18-IL2 and excludes two patients recorded as never treated. Thirteen retained tumors were resected after the first hu14.18-IL2 course (group A), whereas eight were resected before the first course (group B).
dataset.publication_citation: Yang et al. Clinical Cancer Research 2020

metadata.source_program: University of Wisconsin CO05601 / NCT00590824 pilot clinical trial
metadata.library_method: RNA from one representative FFPE melanoma block per patient was captured with Illumina TruSeq RNA Exome and sequenced as 80-bp paired-end reads; the deposited matrix contains source-calculated gene-level RPKM
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival among patients with resectable recurrent stage III or IV melanoma who received hu14.18-IL2
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO provides individual OS time and vital status for every retained patient but does not restate the exact calendar origin. TRACE Explorer therefore exposes source-provided OS without treating this mixed pre/post-treatment expression cohort as untreated natural history.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The source trial deliberately sampled two biological time points across randomized groups: group-A tumors after one hu14.18-IL2 course and group-B tumors before the first course. This context is preserved in each source-metadata record and must be considered when interpreting pooled expression-survival associations.
metadata.disease_selection_note: The source describes recurrent stage III or IV melanoma and does not provide patient-level primary-site labels. The cohort is mapped to the TCGA-SKCM analysis family as advanced melanoma, consistent with the treatment cohorts already represented there, but should not be interpreted as a purely primary-cutaneous cohort.
metadata.overlap_note: The CO05601 hu14.18-IL2 trial is independent of TCGA-SKCM and of the checkpoint-inhibitor and adoptive-cell-therapy cohorts already represented in the catalog.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO matrix in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Resected stage III/IV melanoma before or after the first hu14.18-IL2 course

expression.label: log2(RPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The four symbols repeated only by letter case are excluded with all corresponding rows; the remaining 55,765 symbols are unique case-insensitively.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer selects the 21 treated-patient columns, applies log2(RPKM + 1) once to non-negative source RPKM values and excludes case-insensitive duplicate symbols. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: CO05601 trial follow-up; exact calendar origin is not restated in GEO
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; living patients are censored at the source-provided follow-up
